ASTAP command-line solver (astap_cli)
License: MPL-2.0 (Mozilla Public License, version 2.0)

This distribution bundles astap_cli, the command-line plate solver of ASTAP
(Astrometric STAcking Program). It is redistributed unmodified, exactly as
published upstream, as a separate executable that ASIAIR Commander runs as a
child process; no ASTAP code is compiled into ASIAIR Commander.

astap_cli is licensed under the Mozilla Public License, version 2.0. A copy of
the licence is available at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.

The Source Code Form of ASTAP is available from the upstream project:

  Project: https://sourceforge.net/projects/astap-program/
  Source:  https://sourceforge.net/p/astap-program/code/
           (hg clone http://hg.code.sf.net/p/astap-program/code astap-program-code)
